profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft AI

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed multiple standalone websites for UW Mapping Group and the Capital Projects Office.
Developed an Android app to assist current and prospective students in exploring campus and learning about UW's rich history.

positions.title: Technology Help Desk Lead
positions.description:
Oversaw the management of all student staff.
Assisted in scheduling staff for the Help Desk as well as hiring and training new staff.
Served as the highest escalation point for issues before the involvement of university management.
Ensured quality standards were met in e-mail communications between UW-IT Support and clients.
Created documentation on policies, procedures and standard methods for approaching common issues.
